proposition: In 833/1430 (timeline: c. 833/1429) Ibn Turka failed to obtain a hearing with Shāhrukh in Simnan, then went to Natanz and summoned his family there.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II (1431-32), addressed to Bāysunghur
mediation.note: written to seek intercession from the ruler's son while his case was still unresolved
the text says 833/1430 and the timeline c. 833/1429
